blind.description: A five-light standing candelabra crafted in stylized dark bronze or wrought iron. It features a four-legged scroll foot base, a spiral-twisted central stem, and five branching arms arranged in a symmetrical arc. Each branch terminates in a circular drip pan holding a thick, unlit cream-colored wax candle with a black wick. The surfaces are continuous, solid, and clean with smooth stylized bevels; no parts are broken, floating, or melted together improperly.
blind.from_above: A straight row of five round bobeches/cups with cream candle tops and black wicks, positioned directly above the crossed four-footed base.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 3 ft tall) and around 1.8 to 2 ft wide.
